verdict.rationale: Convex functions (queries, mutations, actions) are deployed serverlessly and can be invoked via SDK calls or exposed as public HTTP endpoints, with no server management required — the platform handles deployment, scaling, and infrastructure. Docs confirm public HTTP endpoints for calling functions and SDK-based invocation is core to the product. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of production HTTP invocation latency/scaling behavior, and more detail on action-specific server-side execution guarantees beyond docs claims.
